A stew made with carrots and potatoes. It can be chicken, beef, or pork. The stock obviously changes. Peas and corn are good additions, celery too.

But basically, a stew made with large chunks of meat with carrots and potatoes.

If you want to make it fast, you can speed it up by steaming the carrots until almost done, then adding the potatoes. When those are done, simply tip out the steam basket into the pot. Make the meat about the size of dice, then brown them in a pan. When they've got good color, cover them. If you start the meat and veg at the same time, you should be able to finish the meat about when the veg are done. Tip them into the pan, then add flavorings and corn/peas/etc. I sometimes add rice or barley.

If you decide to make a lot of it, freeze in small portions. They should last more than a week if frozen solid. If you freeze, don't cook them all the way. When you reheat it, it'll finish cooking.
